# Dangerous Decibels

> > A comprehensive hearing loss prevention initiative by Oregon Health & Science University dedicated to educating communities about noise-induced hearing loss, tinnitus, and hearing protection strategies.

Dangerous Decibels is an evidence-based public health program that combines education, innovative sound measurement tools (JOLENE), and community partnerships to promote hearing conservation. The initiative serves educators, students, and the general public through classroom programs, research initiatives, and awareness campaigns.

## Key Topics

- Noise-induced hearing loss
- Hearing loss prevention
- Tinnitus prevention
- Sound measurement
- JOLENE system
- Decibel levels
- Hearing protection
- Sound-level meter
- Hearing conservation

- Inverse Square Law
- Public health partnership
- Educational resources
- Safe in Sound Award
- Oregon Health & Science University

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [Dangerous Decibels](https://dangerousdecibels.org): Homepage for Dangerous Decibels hearing loss prevention initiative by OHSU
- [About Us](https://dangerousdecibels.org/about-us): Organization overview of Dangerous Decibels mission and programs
- [The Problem](https://dangerousdecibels.org/about-us/the-issues): Overview of noise-induced hearing loss and tinnitus problems
- [The Solution](http://dangerousdecibels.org/about-us/the-solutions): Prevention solutions for noise-induced hearing loss and tinnitus
- [Safe in Sound Innovation Award](https://dangerousdecibels.org/safe-in-sound): Safe in Sound Innovation Award for hearing loss prevention programs

## JOLENE Sound Measurement Tool

- [JOLENE System](https://dangerousdecibels.org/jolene): JOLENE personal stereo sound measurement system for education
- [JOLENE Educational Tool](http://dangerousdecibels.org/education/jolene): JOLENE sound measurement educational tool for hearing loss prevention
- [JOLENE Cookbook](https://dangerousdecibels.org/jolene/cookbook): DIY implementation guide and instructions for JOLENE system
- [Research with JOLENE](https://dangerousdecibels.org/jolene/research): Research initiatives and outreach activities using JOLENE system
- [Jolene's Creator](https://dangerousdecibels.org/jolene/jolenes-creator): Profile of photojournalist Genna Martin who created JOLENE
- [JOLENE Family Album](https://dangerousdecibels.org/jolene/jolene-family-album): Community projects and user submissions featuring JOLENE device

- [Education](https://dangerousdecibels.org/education): Education programs and resources for hearing loss prevention

- [Classroom Materials & Resources](http://dangerousdecibels.org/education/resources): Classroom materials and educator resources for hearing health education
- [Information Center](https://dangerousdecibels.org/education/information-center): Decibel levels, noise exposure guidelines, and ear health information
